item.description:
Perennially underappreciated Jared Goff is off to another great start for the Lions with no turnovers through 5 weeks and on pace for 5k yards passing.
That and more in this week's Inside the Lions https://www.freep.com/story/sports/nfl/lions/2026/10/13/detroit-lions-jared-goff-jahmyr-gibbs/92219185007/
Dan Campbell said at his news conference today Tom Kennedy needs knee surgery and will miss the rest of the season
Greenlaw shouldn't have been suspended for that. He got ejected, that's enough punishment.

"I don’t think anyone can stop us when we’re playing like that, respectfully. And I mean, I think we kind of showed it out there today."
The Lions' problems aren't all fixed, but they're feeling pretty good going into the bye.
https://www.freep.com/story/sports/nfl/lions/2026/10/12/detroit-lions-secret-to-getting-going-white-squall-in-arizona/92203400007/
Jahmyr Gibbs, Jared Goff, DL get high marks in Lions blowout win vs Cardinals https://www.freep.com/story/sports/nfl/lions/2026/10/11/detroit-lions-grades-vs-arizona-cardinals/92203390007/

Detroit Lions lose Devin White to broken forearm on friendly fire play; Tom Kennedy has sprained knee https://www.freep.com/story/sports/nfl/lions/2026/10/11/detroit-lions-injury-updates-devin-white-tom-kennedy/92212078007/

Dan Campbell with a game ball for Lions radio announcer Dan Miller after the game today. Campbell choked back tears as he announced the game ball to Miller, who lost his wife to cancer this week. Prayers to Dan and his family.

The Lions got aggressive - on offense and defense - and it paid off in a big way in a get-right win over the Arizona Cardinals https://www.freep.com/story/sports/nfl/lions/2026/10/11/nfl-week-5-detroit-lions-arizona-cardinals-live-updates-score--live/92198030007/
Victory music from the Lions locker room
Tom Kennedy (knee) and Devin White (forearm) both downgraded to out
Fourth-and-3, Lions keeping their offense on the field again. 4th straight drive they'll go for it on fourth down.

Lions 3 for 3 on 4th downs. Mentioned this in my day-after column last week. Lions are at their best pushing the aggressiveness. Going for it on 4th downs, playing man. They'll lose some, but good that they're back to it today. You can tell the difference. And it helps refs letting DBs play
[contains quote post or other embedded content]
Lions offense cooking now. 3 straight TD drives and it's 21-7, 4:50 left in the first half. And defense has 4 straight 3 and outs.
Jahmyr GIbbs with another good blitz pickup on that pass to Wright. Had one on the TD to LaPorta, too.
Well designed play-action fake on fourth-and-1 goes for a Goff to LaPorta TD. Lions take a 13-7 lead, PAT pending
Ruling on the field stands. Lions lose their challenge. It's fourth-and-inches
Probably shoulda been a PI flag there. Amon-Ra ran into a Cardinals DB, was wide open, maybe a TD.
Three straight 3-and-outs for the Lions defense now ... Amon-Ra takes over PR duties for Tom Kennedy, nearly coughs up a fumble. Lions recover.
Jahmyr Gibbs with his 6th rushing TD of the year and 8th overall ties the game at 7. 12:22 left in the first half.
Tom Kennedy knee injury, questionable
Devin White questionable to return with a forearm injury
Lions: 3 possessions, 3 3-and-outs, 3 sacks allowed. 0 catches by wide receivers/tight ends. 21 second left in the first quarter
Lions go 3 and out for the second time in as many possessions, allow a drive-killing sack again.
And that boot action has been killing the Lions all year. It was Malcolm Rodriguez who overplayed the fake on the TD. Easy throw and catch.
Welp, not a great start again. Lions go 3 and out, Cardinals follow with a nearly 8-minute TD drive, convert 2 third downs and a fourth. Cardinals 7, Lions 0.
The rare second-and-40 in the Jaguars game just now lol

A second-rounder? 😂😂😂

NFL legend Mike Ditka passed away today. Lions coach Dan Campbell recalled a combine interview that was "one of the best times of my life and most intimidating times of my life sitting across from Mike Ditka." https://www.freep.com/story/sports/nfl/lions/2026/10/09/mike-ditka-dead-86-dan-campbell-recalls-interview/92172007007/

Lions eyeing Packers game for Brian Branch, Cade Mays return https://www.freep.com/story/sports/nfl/lions/2026/10/09/dan-campbell-tall-order-for-brian-branch-cade-mays-to-play-vs-cardinals/92171228007/
Dan Campbell on whether Brian Branch will play this weekend: "I think that's a tall order for this week." Said Lions want to be as smart with him as possible. "Love where he's at right now."
